Name: Upgraded Dwarf Statue
Author: TacNotCat
Description:
[b]WHAT IT DOES[/b]
This mod adds a new big craftable, the Dwarf King Statue - Perfect Form. It is a gilded version of the vanilla Statue of the Dwarf King that lets you personally choose which blessing you receive each day, including five enhanced blessings the vanilla statue cannot give.
[b]HOW TO GET IT[/b]
[list=1]
[*]Buy a vanilla Statue of the Dwarf King (the Dwarf in the mines sells it once you can understand Dwarvish, or unlock Mastery).[/*]
[*]Hold it and right-click the Dwarf in the mines. He gives a short introduction and then automatically offers to awaken the statue (no extra click needed after the first time).[/*]
[*]Choose "Awaken the statue" with these materials in your inventory:[/*]
[/list][list]
[*]2 Dwarf Gadget (artifact)[/*]
[*]77 Gold Bars[/*]
[*]1,000,000 gold[/*]
[*]1 Lava Eel[/*]
[/list]The vanilla statue you are holding is consumed in the process.
4. The statue in your hand becomes the Dwarf King Statue - Perfect Form. Place it anywhere.
[b]HOW TO USE[/b]
[list]
[*]Touch the statue once per in-game day to open the blessing picker.[/*]
[*]Pick any of the vanilla Dwarf King blessings or one of the five enhanced versions.[/*]
[*]The picker shows 5 icons per row with name, description and duration on hover; mouse wheel / arrow keys / PageUp-Down switch pages.[/*]
[*]The daily quota is SHARED with the vanilla Statue of the Dwarf King: if you already got a blessing from either statue today, the other one only shakes and refuses until tomorrow.[/*]
[/list][b]ENHANCED BLESSINGS[/b]
[list]
[*]Ore (Enhanced): mining nodes drop 2 ores in total (the vanilla +1 is included).[/*]
[*]Delving (Enhanced): in Skull Cavern, placing a staircase has a 20% chance to become a shaft; anywhere, a 20% chance the staircase is not consumed. Shafts show the vanilla white dust puff.[/*]
[*]Embers (Enhanced): coal bonus doubled - +20% in the mines, +6% outdoors, plus an extra +5% outdoor roll.[/*]
[*]Blasting (Enhanced): bomb fuse 90% shorter (about 0.2 s) and bombs cannot hurt you.[/*]
[*]Prospecting (Enhanced): geode bonus doubled (vanilla x1.25 becomes x1.5).[/*]
[/list][b]CONFIG (config.json in the mod folder, generated on first launch)[/b]
[list]
[*]BombFuseMilliseconds (default 200) - fuse length for the Blasting blessing[/*]
[*]StairSaveChance (default 0.2) - chance a staircase is not consumed[/*]
[*]ShaftChance (default 0.2) - chance a staircase becomes a shaft in Skull Cavern[/*]
[/list][b]LANGUAGES[/b]
Chinese and English are included; names and text follow the game language.
[b]REQUIREMENTS / COMPATIBILITY[/b]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6+ and SMAPI 4.0+.[/*]
[*]Built with Harmony patches; no other mod is required.[/*]
[*]The enhanced blessings only affect vanilla behaviour and do not touch other mods' buffs.[/*]
[/list][b]中文说明[/b]
【AI 翻译】
[b]功能概述[/b]
本模组新增一个大件物品「矮人之王雕像·完全体」：它是原版矮人王雕像的鎏金强化版，让你每天亲自挑选想要的祝福，并额外提供五种原版没有的强化祝福。
[b]如何获得[/b]
[list=1]
[*]先购买原版「矮人王雕像」（能听懂矮人语或在精通山洞解锁后，矿井矮人商店有售）。[/*]
[*]手持它右键矿井里的矮人：他会先说一段介绍，说完自动弹出选项框（首次之后每次右键都直接弹出选项框）。[/*]
[*]背包中备齐以下材料后选择「升级雕像」：[/*]
[/list][list]
[*]2 个矮人小工具（古物）[/*]
[*]77 个金锭[/*]
[*]1,000,000 金币[/*]
[*]1 条岩浆鳗鱼[/*]
[/list]手中的原版雕像本身也会被消耗。
4. 手中的雕像原位变为「矮人之王雕像·完全体」，放到室内外任意位置即可。
[b]如何使用[/b]
[list]
[*]每个游戏日触碰一次雕像，打开祝福选择菜单。[/*]
[*]可选原版矮人王雕像的五种祝福，以及本模组新增的五种强化版。[/*]
[*]菜单每行 5 个图标，悬停显示名称、描述与持续时间；滚轮 / 方向键 / PageUp-Down 翻页。[/*]
[*]每日额度与原版矮人王雕像共用：当天任意一个雕像赐福后，另一个当天只会摇晃并拒绝。[/*]
[/list][b]强化祝福[/b]
[list]
[*]矿脉（强化）：每个采矿节点共掉落 2 块矿石（已含原版 +1）。[/*]
[*]掘进（强化）：骷髅洞穴放楼梯 20% 变竖井；任意地点放楼梯 20% 不消耗；竖井带原版白雾特效。[/*]
[*]炭火（强化）：煤炭加成翻倍——矿井内 +20%、室外 +6%，另有额外 +5% 室外判定。[/*]
[*]爆破（强化）：炸弹引信缩短 90%（约 0.2 秒），且炸弹不再伤害你。[/*]
[*]探矿（强化）：晶球加成翻倍（原版 ×1.25 → ×1.5）。[/*]
[/list][b]配置（config.json，首次启动后生成在模组目录）[/b]
[list]
[*]BombFuseMilliseconds（默认 200）——爆破祝福的引信长度[/*]
[*]StairSaveChance（默认 0.2）——楼梯不消耗的概率[/*]
[*]ShaftChance（默认 0.2）——骷髅洞穴中楼梯变竖井的概率[/*]
[/list][b]语言[/b]
内置中文与英文，名称与文案跟随游戏语言。
[b]前置与兼容[/b]
[list]
[*]需要星露谷物语 1.6+ 与 SMAPI 4.0+。[/*]
[*]使用 Harmony 补丁实现，不依赖其它模组。[/*]
[*]强化祝福只改原版行为，不触碰其它模组的 buff。[/*]
[/list]
